rows.notes: The cited document is explicitly labelled a Review Article; it summarises other authors' IoT, WSN, satellite (Sentinel SAR) and ML flood-monitoring systems and proposes an untested conceptual FMEWS framework (Section 4.3) without reporting any own data, experiment, survey or validated model run. UAVs are mentioned only in passing (Section 2.5, summarising Munawar et al. [19]) and nothing concerns farmers, agriculture, drought adaptation or climate-change adaptation. The claim that UAVs help farmers adapt to droughts and floods via early warning is not supported by any result of this paper.

notes: Review article (no primary data); the extractor's attribution of a UAV-based flood early-detection 'study' to this paper is incorrect <U+2014> it is a literature overview with a proposed but unimplemented framework.
